item.title: Love this! Circa 1911 in Louisiana. $279,000
item.description: Love this house! It has a lot of pretty details! The house was built in 1911. It is located in Morgan City, Louisiana. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, tall ceilings, bead board, wide baseboards, transom windows, crown moulding and a claw foot tub. There is a large back yard, huge patio, big oak trees and a detached storage shed. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,852 square feet. $279,000 Contact Calyn Welch with Simon Real Estate: 985-518-3091 From the Zillow list

item.title: 20 bedrooms! The Merrill House. On 126 acres in Maine. $2,250,000
item.description: This is a huge place with 20 bedrooms! A lot of history with this house. Known as the Merrill House. Originally built in 1790.IT is located on 126 acres in Andover, Maine. In 1900 it was expanded by Henry Varnum Poor, founder of Standard and Poor’s, later the S&P 500. The property has gardens, trails and expansive views. The house is near a lot of outdoor activities. Twenty bedrooms, seven bathrooms and 9,000 square feet. $2,250,000 Contact Coldwell Banker Realty: 207-967-9900 From the Zillow li

The house features covered porches, original wood floors, grand staircase, picture rails, baseboards, original mantels and wainscoting. This is a big house! Six bedrooms, four bathrooms and 6,101 square feet. $349,000 Contact Brian Alderman with Hidden Creek Investments: 919-649-1522 From the Zillow listing: The Edgerton-Pruitt

item.title: California’s most expensive old house listing! Robert Taylor Ranch. $70,000,000
item.description: Welcome to California’s most expensive old house listing! This is a beautiful property! It is known as the Robert Taylor Ranch. Once home to golden age icon, Robert Taylor. The house was built in 1950. It is located on 112 acres in Los Angeles, California. The property consists of a main house, two story guest wing, solar heated pool, outdoor kitchen, two detached guest casitas and a large barn. Nine bedrooms, fifteen bathrooms and 20,000 square feet. $70,000,000 From the Zillow listing: Welcome
